# netbox_asns (Data Source)

Retrieves all asns from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_asns" "asns" {
  filter {
    name  = "asn__gte"
    value = "1000"
  }
  filter {
    name  = "asn__lte"
    value = "2000"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `asns` (Attributes List) The ASNs found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--asns))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.

Read-Only:

- `site_count` (Number) The number of site of the ASNs.
- `sites` (List of Number) The IDs of the sites of the ASNs.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the ASNs.
